Scarlet & Violet series · BLK

Black Bolt

Released July 18, 2025 · 172 cards

StandardExpanded

Black Bolt is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on July 18, 2025. Its main set has 86 cards, plus 86 secret rares numbered beyond the set (172 in total). It includes 161 Pokémon, 10 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
